paper.title_en: Bianchi type-I cosmological models in f(T) theory of gravity
paper.abstract_en: This paper explores late time cosmic acceleration within the context of f(T) Teleparallel gravity. We analyze a non linear quadratic model defined by $f(T)=\alpha T^2+\beta T+\gamma $, and derive the modified Friedmann equation by directly utilizing the gravitational equation of motion to evaluate the exact expression for effective density and pressure. Our result shows that the non linear $\alpha T^2$ terms naturally drives the accelerated expansion of the universe, thus eliminating the necessity of introducing an explicit dark energy fluid. Furthermore, we highlight the dynamical aviation of the model from the standard $\Lambda CDM $ paradigm by tracing the evolution of the effective equations of state parameter to confirm the physical viability of these results, the model constraints are tested against SNe Ia, BAO and CMB data.
